title: Teddy Swims and the Live-Music Partnership
lessons: The player notices a sculptural wave-shaped display, built entirely from White Claw case art, planted near the festival entrance.
The player already knows the wave display from the grocery store and sees a later limited merchandise collection tied to the brand's live-music partnership.

text: Walking up to the festival entrance, you see a wave taller than the gate, built entirely out of White Claw cases.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: That's not an entrance. That's a sculpture.

entry-first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: It's the grocery-store display, but huge. I hauled it out here and let it loom over the gate instead.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You moved the shelf display to the front of a music festival.

entry-first-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Yeah. In the store it's an endcap. Out here nobody's buying a case. It's just the thing you take a photo in front of so people know you got in.

choice-first.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Everybody's stopping for a photo. You going to?

choices.text: That feels like a natural place for you to be.
It's the same store display. You just gave it a bigger stage.
I don't need a can sculpture telling me I've arrived somewhere.

first-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Good. This is the one place I don't have to explain myself.

first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Yep. Same cardboard, taller stack. A landmark is still an endcap. I'm fine with that. Cardboard's cheap.

first-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: That's fair. The festival was here before me. I just got here early and stood by the door.
Merch tent. Next to the artist shirts, there's a small rack with the White Claw logo on it, tied to the Teddy Swims tour.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You want me to wear the campaign now?

entry-return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Limited merch. I know. I know how it sounds.

entry-return-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: The tour thing doesn't stop at the ad. If you like him enough, I get to be in the photo again. On your shirt this time.

choice-return.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: You picked it up. That's further than most people get.

choices.text: I'd wear it if the design is good.
Merch is just turning the ad into something I pay for.
I'm not wearing a hard-seltzer logo.

return-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then it's got to be a good shirt first and a logo second. If it's the other way around, put it back.

return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: That's exactly the risk. I paid for the ad, and now I'm asking you to pay for the ad. I don't have a comeback for that.

return-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then leave the shirt to someone else. Plenty of people will.
